spanish: Y toda ofrenda de sacerdote entera será; no será comida.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated Hebraized noun minjá (H4503, h03006023002) into Spanish as ofrenda, consistent with the same lemma's resolution elsewhere in Levítico 6.

Kept entera in feminine to agree with the Spanish feminine noun ofrenda, even though the Hebrew adjective כָּלִיל (H3632, h03006023004) is morphologically masculine while predicating the feminine noun מִנְחָה; this is the required grammatical choice in Spanish, not a meaning change.
readerNote: The Hebrew adjective כָּלִיל is masculine but predicates the feminine noun מִנְחָה; entera was kept feminine to agree with the Spanish noun ofrenda.
